entities.summary: Somtow Papinian Sucharitkul, commonly known as S. P. Somtow, is a Thai-American musical composer and conductor, and a science fiction, fantasy, and horror author writing in English as both Somtow Sucharitkul and S. Somtow. He has both Thai and American citizenship.
